title: Elmstone Fitness onramp scratchbook
content:
Context / quick summary:
- Elmstone Fitness: mid-size chain (120 studios) wants a localized conversational coach + class recommendation engine.
- Interested in Private deployment (VPC) for PHI-ish telemetry + membership PII. Also wants cold-start embedding sync with their catalog of workouts.

Call notes (2025-01-13, follow-up 01-27):
- Key stakeholders: CTO (Rachel), Head of Product (Marco), SRE lead (Sofia).
- Primary goals: near real-time recommended classes, short chat responses for scheduling, anonymized telemetry ingest for personalization.
- Traffic profile: peak 3k reqs/min for recommendations (morning/evening spikes), steady 200 rps for chat.
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 180ms for recommendations, 95th <= 350ms for chat.
- Data retention/compliance: 1 year retention on personalized vectors, strict PII masking on transcripts.

Tech & constraints spotted:
- Elmstone uses a vendor treadmill API that rate-limits telemetry pushes (burst tolerant). Need batching on their end or an ingress buffer.
- Mobile app currently tokenizes text aggressively (average prompt length 220 tokens) — cost risk.
- They want embeddings for search across class descriptions + user notes; catalog size ~150k docs.
- On-prem data-sandbox for training cohorts — cannot send raw logs to hosted.

Gotchas / risks:
- VPC peering: Elmstone requires cross-account peering to their Azure subscription (they asked about support for Azure ExpressRoute). Confirm networking patterns for Private.
- KV cache warmup: first-hour cold-start heavy; consider pre-warming with top-classes queries.
- Model fallback policy: they asked about using a smaller quantized variant on Dedicated if capacity spikes — need to confirm semantic parity/regression risk.
- Token leakage: front-end currently logs full prompts in crash reports; must add masking before any upstream.

Immediate action items (owner / ETA):
- Marta: draft Private deployment network diagram for Azure ExpressRoute / peering options + list of required firewall rules (ETA 2025-02-04).
- Oliver: run back-of-envelope cost for embedding store (150k docs, embed dim 1536) + estimate monthly K/V cache cost for 3k rpm (ETA 2025-01-30).
- Priya: supply sample prompts & a sanitized transcript subset (anonymize names, emails) so we can run evals (ETA 2025-01-22) — WAITING.
- SE: open internal ticket to evaluate model-variant semantic drift when switching to 4-bit quantized variant (JIRA SEED-4821).

Design notes / early proposals:
- Architecture idea: Private control plane in Redwood with dedicated inference pool in their AZ region. Ingress via customer-managed NLB, VPC peering, TLS terminated at customer edge.
- Caching policy: prefix-based KV cache for class-descriptions + user profile embeddings; TTLs: 1h for session data, 30d for catalog vectors.
- RAG approach: store catalog vectors in managed vector DB (annoy/hnsw) with nightly full-reindex + incremental on update. Use hybrid search: semantic top-50 + BM25 filter by studio availability.
- Rate-limiting: token-based per-API-key + per-studio burst guard. Propagate client-side rate-limit headers to help UX.

Open questions to clarify on next call:
- Can Elmstone tolerate weekly (not daily) embedding syncs? they said near-real-time for new classes but clarified: >95% of catalog static.
- Exact egress/cross-account firewall policy from their side — need sample ACLs.
- Do they need PII redaction inside the model prompts or pre-tokenization step (we recommended pre-tokenization masking).

Notes to self:
- Keep examples small in evals to show token-cost delta (shortened prompts + instruction tuning).
- Prepare a short slide to show a rollback plan if quantized model degrades on scheduling intents.
- Flag legal for data residency language — they might ask for EU-only storage for EU members.

Next meeting: 2025-02-05 10:00 PT (confirm with Marco). Agenda: network diagram review, sample prompts, initial latency/cost numbers.

Random quick scribbles:
- asked about MFA for portal access -> they use Okta SSO (good).
- their analytics team wants streaming events to Kafka -> propose connector in Private deployment.

End of scratchbook — keep this as mutable; convert to a more formal proposal once we have sanitized transcripts and network constraints.
